# PeachBay Furniture

> PeachBay Furniture is a furniture and interior-design business on Nyali Road, Mombasa, Kenya. It offers new and refurbished home and office furniture, custom furniture quotations, home décor, lighting, artificial plants, cement pots, wallpapers, and interior design services including consultation, quotations, house plans, wallpaper installation and furniture fixing.

## Business details
- Website: https://peachbayfurniture.com/
- Phone and WhatsApp: +254 748 333 486
- Email: ombokfelistus@gmail.com
- Address: Nyali Road, Mombasa, Kenya
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm
- Social: peachbay56 on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook
- Delivery: across Kenya; cost depends on location and order size
